title: Manage semantic review lifecycle deterministically
summary: Approved semantic stacks can be published, prepared for a pull request, merged, and archived without ad hoc Git surgery.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The validated active artifact can be committed as a metadata-only commit through a script.
A script creates a named PR-ready branch only when the stage stack and optional metadata commit are valid.
A merged published review can be moved to stable history and committed, leaving no active artifact.
